human_gate: Private Actions, Pages, Giscus, PRA configuration, and official-source person-linked comparison remain deferred pending separate owner authorization and a privacy protocol.
objective: Launch A0, A1, A2, A3, and A4 as a public-only HCJC audit wave while deferring private configuration and official-source comparison gates.

skills.name: aai-cognitive-interface
skills.terminate_when: The public-only wave has a frozen baseline, bounded reports, explicit limits, and a preserved evidence register.
skills.why: Governs custody, source authority, human gates, state, and evidence limits for the live audit wave.

skills.name: claim-source-auditor
skills.terminate_when: A3 and all cross-report factual claims use the required source status taxonomy.
skills.why: Requires atomic claim rows, one claim status, stable locators, and explicit searched scope for provenance work.

skills.name: code-verification
skills.terminate_when: Technical reports distinguish code defects from test and environment limitations.
skills.why: Supplies isolated test design, reproducibility, failure classification, and safe parallel review practices for A2 and A4.

skills.name: research-execution-briefs
skills.terminate_when: Public evidence is current, sourced, and conflicts remain explicit.
skills.why: Supplies current public-source research, source hierarchy, and uncertainty reporting for A1 and A3.

skills.name: firecrawl
skills.terminate_when: Public retrieval outputs are bounded, inspected, and reduced to non-identifying evidence.
skills.why: Provides isolated retrieval of the public site and published artifacts for A1 without relying on repository prose.

skills.name: agent-churn-control
skills.terminate_when: Equivalent checks reuse accepted evidence and every permitted retry has a typed change or failure reason.
skills.why: Controls repeated local checks and requires recorded reasons for any retry or alternate route.

terminate_when: A0 baseline custody, A1, A2, A3, and A4 provisional reports, and an A0 evidence register are persisted without private-state access or production mutation.
